entities.summary: Olga Chernysheva is a contemporary artist who lives and works in Moscow. Her work spans film, photography, drawing and object-based mediums, where she draws on quotidian moments and marginal spaces from everyday life as a way of exploring the increasing fragmentation of master narratives in contemporary Russian culture. Olga Chernysheva was a painters & sculptors from Moscow (b. 1962-10-18, Moscow). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
